environment_spec.name: cellquant-hpc
cuda_notes: Prefer a CUDA 12.8+ (cu128) PyTorch wheel in the shared cellquant-hpc env: covers Hopper (H200) and Blackwell; still lists older arches.
CURC FAQ recommends nvhpc_sdk/2025.251 or newer across Alpine GPUs.
Loading a CUDA module alone does not prove the Python wheel supports the architecture — verify torch.cuda.get_arch_list().
notes: Prefer a validated prebuilt environment when available.
Download standard Cellpose model weights during setup, not during the GPU job.
Setting QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen alone is not an installation strategy.
Default full-GPU request is gpu:h200:1 (141 GB). Never silently substitute MIG.
H200 is not listed for gpu-testing; use a short gpu-normal job for smoke tests.
User-reported faster CellQuant segmentation on H200 vs A100 (not a controlled benchmark).
Heavy I/O on /scratch/alpine; durable results under configured /projects retention.
Real Alpine smoke job not yet recorded — do not claim cluster verified.
